g.text: 91.4 × 38.9 × 20.6 mm · top view · 12 V leads drawn short

circle.title: Servo output 1 (icon numbering): 3-pin 0.1 in header, - ground at the outer edge, + 6 V in the middle, ~ signal toward the LED column; carries 6 V
PWM input 1 (icon numbering): 3-pin 0.1 in header, ~ signal toward the LED column, + in the middle, - ground at the outer edge; PWM from a controller, passed straight through to servo output 1
Servo output 2 (icon numbering): 3-pin 0.1 in header, - ground at the outer edge, + 6 V in the middle, ~ signal toward the LED column; carries 6 V
PWM input 2 (icon numbering): 3-pin 0.1 in header, ~ signal toward the LED column, + in the middle, - ground at the outer edge; PWM from a controller, passed straight through to servo output 2

Servo output 6 (icon numbering): 3-pin 0.1 in header, - ground at the outer edge, + 6 V in the middle, ~ signal toward the LED column; carries 6 V
PWM input 6 (icon numbering): 3-pin 0.1 in header, ~ signal toward the LED column, + in the middle, - ground at the outer edge; PWM from a controller, passed straight through to servo output 6
12 V input: two screw terminals for #6 or M3 ring or fork terminals on 18 AWG or larger wire, + on the left, - on the right as printed; 7-20 V, 12 V nominal
